title: Finite-volume scalar spectral constructive Gibbs measure
statement: On the fixed three-torus, for the real scalar Brazovskii kernel K(k)=m_sh^2+Y(|k|^2-q0^2)^2 with m_sh^2>0 and Y>0, and local potential lambda phi^4/4+gamma phi^6/6 with lambda real and gamma>0, K^{-1} is trace class, every sharp spectral Galerkin Gibbs measure is normalizable, and the full Galerkin sequence converges weakly on L2 to a finite-volume non-perturbative Gibbs measure; common-Gaussian lifted densities converge in L1/total variation and finite-degree smeared cylinder-polynomial correlations converge.
scope: T5 CLOSED@FINITE-VOLUME-REAL-SCALAR-SPECTRAL: real scalar field on T3 with periods 16, positive shell mass, Y>0, arbitrary real lambda, gamma>0, beta=1, and sharp spectral/max-norm Galerkin projectors.
